description: UNIT 1 of bean qou-prjo follow-up to #4829: completes the ⁴He (n=12) leg of F_K(q)=Σ_{λ⊢3A,ℓ(λ)≥3} y_λ(q)·χ^λ(β_K;q)·Δ_λ, which #4829 had recorded as a sandbox compute limit. No native kernel and no truncation were needed — the limit was an implementation artifact (a dense np.eye densifying the sparse CSR Hoefsmit operator, forcing O(dim³) per word letter). The sparse kernel (threerow_chi_sparse.py) is an EXACT reorganisation of the same f64 arithmetic, gated bit-level against the #4829 dense path. FULL ℓ≥3 sum over all 70 partitions of 12. Δ_λ=(−1)^{n(λ)}·dim (PROVED value-only); y_λ via live schur_principal_mpmath (EXPERIMENTAL PROTON ANCHOR, not the muon cache); layer-pure. 0 free parameters; AME not used.

parameters.truncation: none — full ℓ≥3 sum over all 70 partitions of 12
parameters.chi_kernel: sparse CSR Hoefsmit seminormal + batched-column trace (exact reorganisation of the #4829 dense path)
parameters.chi_precision: f64 (no mpfr Rust kernel; precision class unchanged by the reorganisation)

diagnostic_ray_above_q0.why_not_bisected: The ray crossing LOCATIONS are not load-bearing — only which side of q₀ the first sign change falls on matters. Bisecting them at n=12 (~32 s per F evaluation) cost >60 min of wall clock on the first run for digits the f64 character path cannot support anyway. Brackets are reported instead: cheaper, and honest about the available resolution.

caveats: BEYOND-SUBSTRATE DIAGNOSTIC. The 'diagnostic_ray_above_q0' block reports F at q > q₀ ≈ 1.10998 (experimental proton anchor). That is NOT a physical regime and no value on the ray is a prediction; the ray exists only to locate the zero of the analytic object so ⁴He can be placed on the same A-ladder as n=6 and n=9.

NO TRUNCATION was applied: all 70 ℓ≥3 partitions of 12 are summed. A dominant-|Δ_λ| truncation was considered and REJECTED — no rigorous bound on the neglected remainder is available, and an unbounded truncation would not be a result.

χ^λ is f64 (pure-Python Hoefsmit seminormal; no mpfr kernel in this sandbox). The sparse reorganisation changes the COST, not the precision class; it is gated bit-level against the #4829 dense path (max rel diff ~1e-15). Sign conclusions are reported together with the leading/total cancellation ratio so the reader can see how far the total sits above the f64 noise floor.

value_only object: F_K is NOT a binding energy (Δ_λ is value-only). Only the SIGN structure of the ≥3-row trace weighting is tested here. The extensive super-pairwise magnitude term remains OPEN (bean qou-prjo).
